opening: Uncorrected output-copy loses all193 matched half-budget neighbour pairs. Test preserving each row's affine contrast and sharing only its remainder, instead of deleting nonlinear hidden groups as R9 did.
source_indices: All24 existing OP2 sources; separate original R9 odd training sources from even non-fitting sources. Every source remains development-exposed.
fixed_representation: Original two R9 expert-shared matrix_BF16 and bias_total_BF16 tensors, unchanged file/tensorSHA and original odd-only fit. No new fit, coefficient, width or support search.
operator: L_i=existing_affine(V1_i); R_i=TeacherY_i-L_i. At a paid same-step full anchor a, reconstruct Yhat_i=L_i+R_a. Preserve the individual residual stream and current row-constant gate.
new_mechanism: Compress the spatial rows of the nonlinear remainder while preserving all channel directions in the affine backbone. R9 compressed hidden columns of that remainder and is not reopened.
CPU_arithmetic: Evaluate the frozen affine linear map on saved BF16 V1 with CPU BF16 F.linear, then fixed BF16 teacher-minus-affine and affine-plus-anchor operations. Also report ideal FP64 difference geometry. No original FFN forward, original quantizer or CUDA invocation.
primary_graph: Same near and horizontal1x4 pair graphs fixed by R13S0; use actual row IDs and both directions. No coordinate or source enlargement after the result.
baselines: Frozen UB1 StudentY, uncorrected full-output sharing and the same fixed affine map without an anchor. Preserve original R9 compressed failures and all D0 results.
stripe_identity: For a four-row stripe with uniformly random anchor, expected summed ideal gated error is one-half the sum over its six unordered pairwise gated remainder differences. This identity needs no complete observed stripe.
sampling_weights: With uniformn=256 ofM=31668 without replacement, row inclusion=n/M and distinct-pair inclusion=n(n-1)/(M(M-1)). Report a descriptive design-reference stripe-risk estimate; independence of old fitted trajectories/row design and uncertainty are not granted by the identity.
cost: Full affine on allM rows costsD/(2H)=5120/(2*13824); full original FFN onM/4 anchors costs1/4 dense. Sum=0.4351851851851852 of dense projectionMAC. Count fullQ1, affine, anchor Q1/Q2, gather/layout, residual materialization, selectors and gate in any future real FFN timing. No speed is inferred.

hypothesis_contrast.support: Affine contrasts remove enough of neighbouring output variation that remaining sharing is competitive with frozen UB1, particularly outside the original R9 fit cohort.
hypothesis_contrast.negative: Remainder differences remain above UB1; do not run this frozen affine-plus-neighbour-copy model. Distinguish affine representation error from spatial incoherence in the data.

limits: Original fullM BF16 GEMM identity for reducedM anchors is untested. CPU BF16 affine arithmetic is not a native CUDA control. Pair and reference-weighted stripe diagnostics are not executed full stripes, flow, rollout, quality, speed or deployable dynamic anchor value.
